integration_guide.title: Assess applicability
integration_guide.description: Check project platform, requirements, architecture and applicable conditions for Security Principles; record exclusions and approved overrides.

integration_guide.title: Apply rules
integration_guide.description: Include applicable Security Principles rules in design, implementation and review checklist; link relevant requirement and code.

integration_guide.title: Verify compliance
integration_guide.description: Review evidence, run relevant automated checks, record failures and follow-up work before completion.

common_issues.cause: Project profile does not explicitly reference the standard or its owner.
common_issues.solution: Attach standard by code to project profile, assign owner and check compliance before change approval.

common_issues.issue: Written standard is not enforceable automatically
common_issues.cause: Some behaviour depends on design decisions and runtime context.
common_issues.solution: Pair automated lint/tests with manual review and recorded acceptance evidence.
